requirements.quote: Endpoints acknowledge all packets they receive and process.  However,
requirements.condition: An endpoint receives and processes a packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not leave a received and processed packet unacknowledged.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet receipt and processing can be observed and compared with the endpoint's acknowledgment state or subsequently emitted ACK frames.

requirements.quote:
only ack-eliciting packets cause an ACK frame to be sent within the
   maximum ack delay.  Packets that are not ack-eliciting are only
   acknowledged when an ACK frame is sent for other reasons.
requirements.condition: An endpoint receives and processes an ack-eliciting packet.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint sends an ACK frame within the maximum acknowledgment delay.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can classify an incoming packet as ack-eliciting and measure whether an ACK frame is sent before the maximum acknowledgment delay expires.

requirements.quote:
only ack-eliciting packets cause an ACK frame to be sent within the
   maximum ack delay.  Packets that are not ack-eliciting are only
   acknowledged when an ACK frame is sent for other reasons.
requirements.required_behavior: The packet is acknowledged when an ACK frame is sent for another reason.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The non-ack-eliciting packet must not by itself cause an ACK frame to be sent within the maximum acknowledgment delay.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver only a non-ack-eliciting packet, observe that it does not independently trigger an ACK, and verify its acknowledgment when another reason causes an ACK frame.

requirements.quote:
When sending a packet for any reason, an endpoint SHOULD attempt to
   include an ACK frame if one has not been sent recently.  Doing so
   helps with timely loss detection at the peer.
requirements.condition: An endpoint is sending a packet for any reason and has not sent an ACK frame recently.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint should attempt to include an ACK frame in the packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet transmission history and the frames included in the outgoing packet can be inspected to determine whether the endpoint attempts ACK inclusion under the stated condition.
